title: Sync Tools configuration
description: Named FTP, SFTP, or SSH connection environments.

^host$.$comment: Required server host name or IP address.

^port$.$comment: Connection port; FTP defaults to 21 and SFTP/SSH default to 22.

^password$.$comment: Login password. Use either this or privateKeyPath for SSH/SFTP authentication.

^privateKeyPath$.$comment: Private-key file path for SSH/SFTP authentication. Use either this or password.

^secretKeyPath$.$comment: Encryption-key file path used by the Encrypt and Decrypt commands.

^proxy$.$comment: Use the extension's configured proxy. Defaults to false.

^retries$.$comment: Number of initial SFTP connection retries. Defaults to 1.

^retry_factor$.$comment: Backoff multiplier for initial SFTP connection retries. Defaults to 2.

^retry_minTimeout$.$comment: Minimum retry delay in milliseconds for initial SFTP connections. Defaults to 25000.

^upload_on_save$.$comment: Upload a file immediately after save. When enabled, watch, submit_git_before_upload, compress, and deleteRemote are ignored.

^watch$.$comment: Watch upload paths for changes. Ignored when upload_on_save is true.

^submit_git_before_upload$.$comment: Commit and push local Git changes before upload to reduce accidental remote overwrites.

^submit_git_msg$.$comment: Git commit message used when submit_git_before_upload is enabled; an empty value prompts for one.

^build$.$comment: Local build command to run before deployment. It is not run in an untrusted workspace.

^compress$.$comment: Upload a compressed archive instead of individual files. Defaults to false.

^remote_unpacked$.$comment: Unpack a compressed upload on the remote host. Defaults to true for SSH and false otherwise.

^delete_remote_compress$.$comment: Delete the uploaded remote archive after extraction. Defaults to true for SSH and false otherwise.

^delete_local_compress$.$comment: Delete the temporary local archive after a compressed upload. Defaults to true for SSH and false otherwise.

^distPath$.$comment: Local path or paths to upload. The workspace root is used when omitted.

^upload_to_root$.$comment: When distPath has one directory, upload its contents directly to remotePath.

^deleteRemote$.$comment: Delete the remote distPath target before uploading. Defaults to false.

^syncFileTime$.$comment: Set the remote file timestamp to the local file timestamp after upload. Defaults to false.

^skipIfSame$.$comment: Compare remote files before upload and skip identical files. Defaults to true.

^skipCompareMode$.$comment: Comparison used by skipIfSame. Defaults to size+mtime.

^uploadDelay$.$comment: Seconds to wait after the last change before an upload_on_save upload. Defaults to 0.

^remotePath$.$comment: Remote target directory for SFTP and SSH uploads.

^excludePath$.$comment: Upload exclusions for this environment, merged with extension exclusions and .gitignore when enabled.

^downloadPath$.$comment: Local destination for manual downloads. The workspace root is used when omitted.

^downloadExcludePath$.$comment: Files and directories to exclude from downloads.

^localTraversalConcurrency$.$comment: Concurrent local directory scans. Set 1 for serial asynchronous I/O; defaults to 4.

^downloadTraversalConcurrency$.$comment: Concurrent remote directory scans. Set 1 for serial traversal; defaults to 2.

^default$.$comment: Use this environment for quick Explorer upload and remote comparison actions. Defaults to false.
